intro.title: A class is a blueprint for objects
intro.body: __init__ sets up each new object. self is the object being worked on, and methods read or change its attributes.

challenges.explanation: The object stores Rex in self.name, and speak() returns that name with text added.

challenges.prompt: Type the character missing at the end of the method line.
challenges.explanation: def lines end with a colon, including methods.

challenges.prompt: Arrange this into a class with a method, then a call to that method.
challenges.explanation: Define the class, its constructor, its method, then create the object and call the method.

challenges.prompt: Calling this method raises an error. Tap the line and choose the fix.
challenges.explanation: Every instance method receives the object as its first parameter, conventionally named self.
